quick_skim.title: Sublattice-resolved coherent phonon dynamics in charge density waves
quick_skim.abstract: Phonons govern fundamental material properties and play a central role in various electronic phase transitions. Coherent driving of specific phonon modes enables on-demand phase control, motivating sublattice-resolved identification of real-space phonon motions. Yet experimentally resolving these motions remains challenging, limiting precise phonon-based control. Here, we introduce a dynamical protocol to track element-resolved phonon dynamics in the charge density wave material EuTe4, in which the dominant Te-sublattice charge order is accompanied by a previously unreported Eu-sublattice component. We leverage the elemental selectivity of time-resolved resonant X-ray scattering to reveal three coherent phonon modes with distinct sublattice character, thereby disentangling Eu- and Te-dominated lattice dynamics, in good agreement with theoretical calculations of the phonon eigenvectors. This time-domain approach, which surpasses the energy-resolution limits of conventional frequency-domain inelastic scattering, provides a broadly applicable framework for decomposing coherent phonons in multi-element materials, which is crucial for the targeted control of phases of matter.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper introduces a dynamic protocol using time-resolved resonant X-ray scattering to track sublattice-resolved coherent phonons in EuTe4, revealing three distinct phonon modes and an unexpected Eu-sublattice component, advancing element-specific phonon control in materials.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 相干声子调控是控制材料相变的重要途径，但实空间亚晶格分辨的声子运动一直难以直接测量。本文提出一种动力学方案，利用时间分辨共振X射线散射对电荷密度波材料EuTe4进行元素选择性探测，从而区分不同Te和Eu亚晶格的贡献。实验揭示了三个具有不同亚晶格特征的相干声子模式，并发现了此前未知的Eu亚晶格分量。该工作为研究复杂材料中声子耦合与相变机制提供了新的实验途径。
